text:
𝗛𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗢𝗬 𝟭𝟯𝟳 𝘃𝘀 𝗥𝗔𝗕𝗔𝗗𝗔 𝟱! 🔥

Bangladesh 327/6 on Day 1 at the Wanderers.
Hridoy made 137; Rabada took 5/51, his 18th Test five-for.
Litton Das is 92* overnight.

Who wins Day 2? 👇
